name: com.brainworks.bwaudio
description:
Unity control client for the bwaudio spatial-audio engine: a thin P/Invoke binding over the engine's C ABI (no audio crosses the boundary, only control). Drives a 26-speaker CAVE array over ASIO/Dante with a binaural debug monitor. Provides a centralized per-frame push (BwAudio) and a positional emitter (BwEmitter).

Windows x64 only (ASIO is Windows-only). Ships the native engine (bwaudio.dll + phonon.dll) — see the README for the required project setup (disable Unity's built-in audio).
